name: WHO-5 Well-Being Index
instructions: Please indicate for each of the five statements which is closest to how you have been feeling over the last two weeks.

responseScale.label: More than half of the time
Less than half of the time

items.text: I have felt cheerful and in good spirits
I have felt calm and relaxed
I have felt active and vigorous
I woke up feeling fresh and rested
My daily life has been filled with things that interest me

scoring.interpretation: A low score is a screening signal for further assessment, not a diagnosis.
